packs.title: Bays to Back Bay
packs.promise: Explore coast, wetlands, museums and history across separate Virginia Beach outings.

q.s: Read a trail and a habitat together.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose one open short trail segment from the state trail guide and notice its surface or canopy.
Record a safe return point and one habitat detail, without depending on a wildlife sighting.

q.s: Study care without demanding a sighting.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose one aquatic habitat from an admitted gallery or the aquarium's official visitor material.
Describe a tank or habitat design choice and one question about the animal's needs.

q.s: Compare two ways people use Sandbridge.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From open public park areas or the city map, identify the fishing pier and a beach-access path.
Describe how their rules differ without requiring fishing or an event.

packs.title: Oceanfront and ViBe
packs.promise: Walk the Oceanfront and nearby arts streets over one or two afternoons.

q.s: Observe a working pier without needing to fish.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From the public boardwalk, identify the pier's relation to the shore and a posted access rule.
Record a safe boardwalk approach and one question about pier use or repair.

q.s: Notice public art without relying on one mural lasting forever.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Use the city's current public-art map to choose one accessible mural along open streets.
Record a color or shape choice and the street corner; do not reproduce artist text as a quotation.

q.s: Read scale and myth in a public sculpture.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From the open public path or the destination's official images, identify a scale or material detail of the statue.
Sketch one shape and compare its size with a person without climbing or touching it.
